_original_lore: The Headless Horseman is a boss that can only
be spawned by buying the horseman's candle from
the Fear Mongerer during the Spooky Festival.
It can be spawned at any time during the night
in the Graveyard or the Wilderness.
name: 无头骑士 (首领)

source: The Headless Horseman is a boss that can only
be spawned by buying the horseman's candle from
the Fear Mongerer during the Spooky Festival.
loreParagraphs.translation: 无头骑士是一个只能在幽灵节期间从 Fear Mongerer 处购买无头骑士蜡烛来生成的首领.

source: It can be spawned at any time during the night
in the Graveyard or the Wilderness.
loreParagraphs.translation: 它可以在夜晚的任何时候在墓园或荒野中生成.
生物类型: ☽ 幽灵, 🦴 骷髅, ☮ 动物
